prior_attribution_check.key_credit: Unchanged published Nov4–6 key with original provenance.

limits: The three-part header and consecutive 1/2/3 labels establish the family; the heavily damaged separate p124 B is excluded.
All native source lengths 352/266/48 match the scan. Restoring source-defined boundaries and visible OCR-omitted glyphs is separate from the six proposed coordinate substitutions.

The raw KOOVES name string, A1 final 0 label and A2 spelling GENERLSTABSOFFIZIERE remain unchanged. A supplied A appears only in brackets in the readable German layer, not in either decoded stream or the fixed-position count.
All source numbers, rank labels and references remain literal; no independent identification of KOOVES or a global numeric map is claimed.

A1 reports negotiations and the requested departure of German troops. A2 reports an assignment to send two officers and requests instructions. Neither statement establishes that those actions were completed.
The old OCR corpus is preserved. Its extra symbols, masks, missing final A3 row and lost part boundary are explicitly replayed against the new source transcription.
A1 earlier body credit and published key provenance are retained. No historical first-solution claim is made; exact re-encryption establishes compatibility, not historical uniqueness.
